brand_identity.name: Septa Group
brand_identity.target_audience: Institutional clients, Commercial developers, Premium residential owners in Kerala

typography.import_instruction: Import fonts via Google Fonts in index.css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600&family=Sora:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap');

styles.h1: text-4xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl tracking-tight leading-[1.1] font-light text-primary
styles.h2: text-3xl md:text-5xl tracking-tight leading-tight font-light text-primary
styles.overline: text-xs md:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-semibold text-muted-foreground

body.weights: 300 (Light) for large paragraphs, 400 (Regular) for standard text

semantic_usage.cards_surfaces: bg-white/50 or bg-white (for contrast against Linen)
semantic_usage.secondary_buttons: bg-transparent border border-[#1F2328] text-[#1F2328] hover:bg-[#1F2328] hover:text-white
semantic_usage.accents: text-[#C6A15B] (Golden Bronze) for lines, icons, active states

layout_and_spacing.whitespace_rule: Use 2x standard padding. If you think p-4 is enough, use p-8.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-none (Sharp edges) or rounded-sm (2px) for a technical feel. DO NOT use rounded-xl or rounded-2xl.

visual_enhancers.shadows: No heavy shadows. Use subtle borders or 1px lines to define space.
visual_enhancers.gradients: FORBIDDEN. Use solid colors and textures.
visual_enhancers.textures: Add a subtle noise overlay to the #F3F0E8 background if possible to feel like paper/stone.

buttons.primary: h-12 px-8 bg-[#0F5E5B] text-white font-medium text-sm uppercase tracking-wider hover:bg-[#0F5E5B]/90 transition-colors rounded-none
buttons.outline: h-12 px-8 border border-[#1F2328]/20 text-[#1F2328] font-medium text-sm uppercase tracking-wider hover:bg-[#1F2328] hover:text-white transition-all rounded-none
buttons.text: text-[#0F5E5B] font-semibold hover:text-[#C6A15B] underline-offset-4 hover:underline transition-colors

cards.project_card: group relative overflow-hidden aspect-[4/5] bg-gray-200 cursor-pointer
cards.service_card: p-8 border border-[#1F2328]/10 bg-white hover:border-[#C6A15B] transition-colors duration-300

forms.input: h-12 bg-white border-0 border-b border-[#1F2328]/20 focus:border-[#0F5E5B] focus:ring-0 px-0 rounded-none transition-colors placeholder:text-muted-foreground/50
forms.label: text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-[#1F2328]/60 mb-2

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. THEME SETUP: Update tailwind.config.js with the exact colors provided. Note that 'background' is NOT white, it is #F3F0E8. This is the key to the premium feel.
2. TYPOGRAPHY: Ensure 'Sora' is used for all Headings (h1-h4) and 'Inter' for body. Use lighter weights (300/400) for large text to look elegant.
3. COMPONENT STYLE: Override default Shadcn rounded-md/lg with rounded-none or rounded-sm. Septa Group is about engineering precision, so sharp corners work best.
4. WHITESPACE: Do not clutter. If a section feels empty, it is correct. 'Negative space is a luxury'.
5. NAVIGATION: Make the navbar sticky with a glassmorphism effect (backdrop-blur-md bg-[#F3F0E8]/80) but keep it minimal.
6. IMAGES: Use object-cover for all images. Ensure aspect ratios are consistent in grids.
7. ADMIN PANEL: For the /admin routes, switch to a denser Mode B grid but keep the color palette consistent (Clean white backgrounds for data density).
8. FORBIDDEN: Do not use gradients, drop shadows (except very subtle ones), or rounded-full buttons (except icon buttons).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
